name: Gonta
source:
A plush toy that [url=/c2021]Kanoha[/url] always carries with her. Gonta calls her his "master", to whom he has given his absolute obedience.
When Kanoha gets angry, he always takes a submissive and devoted position.
Although Gonta physically has no gender because he is merely a stuffed toy, he owns a cheeky male tone of voice.
